description.value: Tinhorn Creek Vineyards is a landmark South Okanagan estate winery with over 30 years of history on the Golden Mile Bench near Oliver, BC, recognized as Canada's first carbon-neutral winery. The property includes the full-service Miradoro Restaurant with sweeping valley views, a guest house, guided wine tastings, and an outdoor amphitheatre that hosts a summer Sunset Concert Series. It is a natural destination-stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine country route.
